system.name: HEST-1k
system.one_liner: A dataset of 1,229 spatial transcriptomics profiles linked to H&E whole-slide images, with a Python library and three use cases.

content.variant_note: five lettered panels: dataset statistics (a), the library (b) and three applications (c, d, e), a deliverables triptych stretched to a 2 + 3 grid; panel a is a dashboard, b and c small pipelines, e a small two-encoder model
content.argues: HEST-1k is more than a dataset: with its library it supports a benchmark, biomarker exploration and multimodal learning, over a broad range of organs, technologies and species.
content.subject: dataset dashboard, library pipeline from legacy readers to per-sample assets, and three application mini-schematics

new_tags.what: a panel of sorted horizontal bars and pies in one sequential colour scale giving the counts of a dataset, tucked together so the empty corner of one chart holds another

lessons.what_to_learn: A dataset paper can open with one lettered grid: a statistics dashboard for scope, a library pipeline whose last row shows what one sample contains as page-shaped cards, and tiny schematics for each downstream use.
lessons.suits: dataset or benchmark papers that ship a software library and several downstream uses, in a figure that must stand in for the paper's whole contribution list.

evidence: HEST-1k comprises 1,229 samples from 153 cohorts encompassing 26 organs, two species
a Python package for interacting with HEST-1k data and assembling new samples as they become available
Applications of HEST-1k include benchmarking foundation models for histology (c.), biomarker exploration (d.) and multimodal representation learning (e.)

summary: HEST-1k is a dataset of 1,229 spatial transcriptomics profiles, each paired with an H&E whole-slide image and metadata, released with the HEST-Library and three use cases. The figure is a five-panel grid. Panel a. is a dashboard of sorted organ bars, a sample-type chart and technology and species pies in one blue scale. Panel b. shows the library: legacy readers, three tissue-processing tiles on the same slide, and a row of five page-shaped cards for the assets of one sample. Two arrows labelled Query and Assemble tie a. and b. together. Panels c., d. and e. are small schematics for the benchmark, biomarker exploration and aligned multimodal encoders.
summary_zh: HEST-1k 是配对空间转录组与 H&E 切片的数据集，附软件库和三个应用。图分五格：a 用蓝色条形图和饼图展示规模，b 展示库的读取、组织处理及每个样本的五类文件，c、d、e 以小示意图呈现基准、标志物探索和多模态对齐。
notes: Prior kinds kept and model-anatomy added for panel e. The red and green frames on the alignment crops are read as before and after; the paper text does not say so. The direction and meaning of Query and Assemble are taken from the arrows as drawn. Medium of icons is a guess from the sizes in the digest.
